notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla parses Interface/GlueXML/GlueStrings.lua off the player's client data (KEY = "value" lines) for the glue screens' localized paragraphs and captions, never embedding Blizzard text. MSUI does the same: Formats/GlueStrings.cs loads the table from client data and the create screen quotes the FACTION_INFO_*/RACE_INFO_*/ABILITY_INFO_* paragraphs and captions from it, with graceful absence.
